<function=python>
<parameter=code>
# Get positions of all 9 green blocks
seg = current_frame.segmentation
greens = [n for n in seg['nodes'] if n['color'] == 'N']

# Calculate center of each green block
click_positions = []
for g in greens:
    boundary = g['boundary']
    rows = [p[0] for p in boundary]
    cols = [p[1] for p in boundary]
    center_r = (min(rows) + max(rows)) // 2
    center_c = (min(cols) + max(cols)) // 2
    click_positions.append((center_r, center_c))

print(f"Green block centers: {click_positions}")

# Click all 9 green blocks
for pos in click_positions:
    result = action([{'action': 'MOUSE', 'row': pos[0], 'col': pos[1]}])
    if result.get('level_completed'):
        print(f"LEVEL COMPLETED after clicking ({pos[0]}, {pos[1]})!")
        break
    
    # Check remaining greens
    seg = current_frame.segmentation
    greens = [n for n in seg['nodes'] if n['color'] == 'N']
    print(f"After click ({pos[0]}, {pos[1]}): greens={len(greens)}")
</parameter>
</function>
</tool_call>
